title: Compose and cancel a common scalar compatibility
statement: Let Λ0, Λ1, Λ2 be commutative condensed ring objects, and let a:Λ0→Λ1, b:Λ1→Λ2, c:Λ0→Λ2 be ring-object maps with a b=c. Let Y be any scheme and let d0,d1,d2 be Diagrams of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category] for lines L0,L1,L2. Let m01,m12,m02 be the underlying sheaf line maps with m01 m12=m02 on every scheme. Assume the two m12 maps at ProjectiveLine Y and diagonalSurface Y have Semilinear structures along b as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints]. Given ScalarCompatibility along a from d0 to d1 [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars], existence of ScalarCompatibility along c from d0 to d2 is equivalent to existence of ScalarCompatibility along b from d1 to d2. No flatness, Noetherian, finiteness, coefficient-colimit, trace-construction or integration-construction assertion is included.

source.place: paragraph (2), scalar associativity and compatibility of finite and colimit legs

proof.text: Use normalized scalar endpoint composition. Construct regular semilinear maps, and identify supported map compositions on underlying sheaves. Cancel the first endpoint isomorphism to construct the second normalized endpoint, or compose the first two to construct the composite endpoint. The normalization determines both unshifted and shifted arrows.

For q and both projections obtain second-leg and composite normalized restriction squares and the scalar mate composition law. Combine it with shifted endpoint composition and mate naturality to derive the composition equation for the complete trace-domain arrow.

Associator naturality and the first trace equation reduce each composite trace equation to the second one by cancellation of the invertible first complete trace-domain arrow. Two-out-of-three proves equivalence of mate invertibility on the shifted line. Apply the same cancellation to the supported-source and shifted-line arrows for delta. Assemble every field of ScalarCompatibility in both directions.

    {Λ₀ Λ₁ Λ₂ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}

    (a : Λ₀ ⟶ Λ₁) (b : Λ₁ ⟶ Λ₂) (c : Λ₀ ⟶ Λ₂)
    [IsMonHom a] [IsMonHom b] [IsMonHom c] (Y : Scheme.{u})

    (L₁ : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules Λ₁ X)
    (L₂ : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules Λ₂ X)

    (d₀ : Diagram Λ₀ Y L₀) (d₁ : Diagram Λ₁ Y L₁) (d₂ : Diagram Λ₂ Y L₂)
    (hcoeff : a ≫ b = c) (hline : ∀ X, m₀₁ X ≫ m₁₂ X = m₀₂ X)
    (h₀₁ : ScalarCompatibility a Y L₀ L₁ m₀₁ d₀ d₁)
    (sP : Semilinear b (L₁ (ProjectiveLine Y)) (L₂ (ProjectiveLine Y))
      (m₁₂ (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (sW : Semilinear b (L₁ (diagonalSurface Y)) (L₂ (diagonalSurface Y))
      (m₁₂ (diagonalSurface Y))) :
    Nonempty (ScalarCompatibility c Y L₀ L₂ m₀₂ d₀ d₂) ↔
      Nonempty (ScalarCompatibility b Y L₁ L₂ m₁₂ d₁ d₂)
